alerts_own_rows.name: alerts_own_rows
alerts_own_rows.withCheck: user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and not exists (select 1 from unnest(alerts.transaction_ids) x(id) where not exists (select 1 from transactions t where t.id = x.id))

audit_log_own_rows.name: audit_log_own_rows
audit_log_own_rows.withCheck: user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and (audit_log.proposal_id is null or exists (select 1 from proposed_actions p where p.id = audit_log.proposal_id))

bills_own_rows.name: bills_own_rows
bills_own_rows.withCheck: user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and (bills.account_id is null or exists (select 1 from accounts p where p.id = bills.account_id))

budgets_own_rows.name: budgets_own_rows
budgets_own_rows.withCheck: user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and (budgets.category_id is null or exists (select 1 from categories p where p.id = budgets.category_id))

rules_own_rows.name: rules_own_rows
rules_own_rows.withCheck: user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and (rules.category_id is null or exists (select 1 from categories p where p.id = rules.category_id))

statements_own_rows.name: statements_own_rows
statements_own_rows.withCheck: user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and (statements.account_id is null or exists (select 1 from accounts p where p.id = statements.account_id)) and (statements.import_id is null or exists (select 1 from imports p where p.id = statements.import_id))

transaction_tags_own_rows.name: transaction_tags_own_rows
transaction_tags_own_rows.withCheck: user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and (transaction_tags.transaction_id is null or exists (select 1 from transactions p where p.id = transaction_tags.transaction_id)) and (transaction_tags.tag_id is null or exists (select 1 from tags p where p.id = transaction_tags.tag_id))

transactions_own_rows.name: transactions_own_rows
transactions_own_rows.withCheck: user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) and (transactions.account_id is null or exists (select 1 from accounts p where p.id = transactions.account_id)) and (transactions.statement_id is null or exists (select 1 from statements p where p.id = transactions.statement_id)) and (transactions.category_id is null or exists (select 1 from categories p where p.id = transactions.category_id)) and (transactions.transfer_account_id is null or exists (select 1 from accounts p where p.id = transactions.transfer_account_id)) and (transactions.transfer_pair_id is null or app_owns_transaction(transactions.transfer_pair_id))
